token.description: 256-bit random bearer capability, returned once; keep in browser memory only.

content.description: Trimmed plain text, never trusted system instructions.

pagePath.description: Optional retrieval hint in spirit, required field in v1; send current pathname, without query/fragment. Never fetch this URL.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: Opaque signed cursor; do not parse or construct on the client.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 24-hour owner/method/path scoped replay key. Reusing with different input409.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Session-bound token for all state-changing owner requests.

OwnerSession.name: portfolio_session
OwnerSession.description: Secure HttpOnly owner session established through OIDC. Mutations also require X-CSRF-Token.

ChatSessionToken.description: Opaque anonymous session capability; authorizes only the matching chat session, never owner/admin access.
